subject: STABLE gpu/metal/tegu/{render_pipeline.inc,render_encoder.inc,library_frontend.inc} (encode-cpu step 1)
body: Tree gate-equal to lead's c6l baseline with my edits on top of the lead's uncommitted hunks. Hashes: render_pipeline.inc 119189b0..., render_encoder.inc 8f785469..., library_frontend.inc 4f380d64.... Changes: (1) library_frontend.inc tegu_owned_class: libobjc entry points resolved once, classes cached per literal (was dlopen+3 dlsym+objc_getClass per call, ~10-15 calls/draw on device). (2) render_pipeline.inc: exact per-pipeline 4-way memo of tegu_air_render_pipeline_plan_generic_specialized (key = compiled ptr, draw, layouts, named resource fields; vertex-layout-slot buffer records keyed by a validated marker since generic_plan_mode replaces that binding by {0,bytes} and only bounds-checks offset/length - documented, raw kept if the plan has a descriptor buffer at that slot). Host builds re-run planner on every hit and abort on any byte diff (TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_VERIFY=0 disables). (3) variant memo: skip SHA key (16 us) when (rt,options,tile,spec) equals one of last 2; host verify recomputes key. Invalidation: prepare (plan memo), set_modules/clear_variants (variant memo), dealloc. (4) render_encoder.inc: planner call -> tegu_render_plan_generic_cached; TEGU_PERF_ENCODE gains plan_hit= plan_miss=. Gates: run_host_tests 48 PASS stops at NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN (same as c6l); render harness rc0 (2 PASS, same 32 COMMAND_FAILED lines as c6l); integration --candidate checks=1005 required_failures=2 only CoreAnimation pass 66/42 (identical to c6l); CA test ASan+release PASS with verify on; device-flag -fsyntax-only -Werror rc0 (also with TILE_FETCH/JM_BATCH defaults). Host 200-draw encode (thread CPU, -O2, steady): 9.5 ms -> 1.7 ms (plan 4.6->0.1, variant 3.2->0.1); memo hits 2056/2074. Caveat: bench binds constant fragment-buffer offsets; CA uniform ring offsets will miss - device plan_hit/plan_miss will tell.
